approved_or_marketed.name: Avance Nerve Graft
approved_or_marketed.indication: Repair of peripheral nerve discontinuities (sensory, mixed, and motor nerve gaps)
approved_or_marketed.regulatory_status: FDA BLA approved December 2025 under Accelerated Approval; commercial launch of licensed biologic product expected Q2 2026. Distributed under HCT/P enforcement discretion since 2007.
approved_or_marketed.key_pivotal_trial: RECON (NCT01809002) Phase 3 completed; primary endpoint met.

approved_or_marketed.name: Axoguard Nerve Connector
approved_or_marketed.modality: Class II medical device (porcine small intestine submucosa nerve conduit)
approved_or_marketed.indication: Repair of peripheral nerve transections where gap closure can be achieved by flexion
approved_or_marketed.regulatory_status: FDA 510(k) cleared; manufactured by Evergen, distributed by Axogen.

approved_or_marketed.name: Axoguard Nerve Protector
approved_or_marketed.modality: Class II medical device (porcine small intestine submucosa nerve wrap)
approved_or_marketed.indication: Repair of peripheral nerve damage with no gap or flex-closable gap

approved_or_marketed.name: Axoguard Nerve Cap
approved_or_marketed.modality: Class II medical device (chambered nerve cap)
approved_or_marketed.indication: Protection and preservation of terminated nerve ends; symptomatic neuroma management

approved_or_marketed.name: Axoguard HA+ Nerve Protector
approved_or_marketed.modality: Class II medical device (hyaluronic-acid-coated nerve protector)
approved_or_marketed.indication: Peripheral nerve protection (incl. revision cubital tunnel decompression)

approved_or_marketed.name: Avive+ Soft Tissue Matrix
approved_or_marketed.regulatory_status: Marketed under Section 361 PHS Act / 21 CFR Part 1271; launched Q2 2024.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Axogen is a peripheral nerve repair medtech / biologic company. Its only Phase 3 program (Avance Nerve Graft, RECON pivotal NCT01809002) was approved by FDA under BLA in December 2025 and has now transitioned to commercial product. All Axoguard devices are FDA 510(k) cleared and commercially marketed. Remaining active studies are registries, post-market device feasibility studies, or planned Phase 4 PMR work — no investigational P1/P2/P3 assets in development.
